newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-NOTTS ALLOWED TO REPLACE INJURED ZAHID.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NOTTS ALLOWED TO REPLACE INJURED ZAHID.

text.p: Nottinghamshire were given permission to replace their injured new overseas signing Mohammed Zahid by the England and Wales Cricket Board registrations committee on Friday.

The 20-year-old Pakistan fast bowler was recruited as a replacement for New Zealander Chris Cairns,who asked for time to recuperate from back trouble, but he has failed to play a single game since arriving in England on May 2.
Zahid, rated one of the fastest bowlers in the world, has been diagnosed as having a stress fracture of the back and is unlikely to figure again this season.
